narrative.details:
What the Blackrock orcs don't understand is that this is a war of attrition. Their brazen push into Alliance territory has left them vulnerable and without supplies, relying on the surrounding mountains to gather resources.

An army can't run on empty bellies, adventurer. Go to their encampments south of Stonewatch Keep to the east and rob them of their food and weapons. Let's see the orcs' fighting spirit when they're starved and defenseless.
narrative.objectives: Bring 10 Battleworn Axes to Marshal Marris in Lakeshire.
narrative.offerRewardText: Excellent work, Eraina. With the Blackrock orcs cut off from their allies in the Burning Steppes, they will have no hope of maintaining their foothold here without proper supplies.
narrative.requestItemsText: Most of what you find will have been raided from Lakeshire anyway. It will do me good to know our people will thrive while the orcs wither.
